detaileddescription.para: A MonomialIdeal is an immutable object, having a base ring. The base ring should be a polynomial ring or quotient of one. In case a quotient is given, the monomial ideal is considered to be in the commutative quotient ring whose quotient elements are the lead terms of the quotient polynomials. Each monomial ideal is represented by its minimal generators only
